title: Rust authenticated fragmentation API is unavailable in no_std builds
description: The auth-policy change gates the only public FragmentSender::new, FragmentationPolicy::accept_peer, and production AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext issuance behind feature=std; new_unchecked is private. lichen-schc therefore compiles no_std only because outbound authenticated fragmentation is dead/unconstructible, violating the embedded-default contract. Design a no_std-capable Link evidence/policy interface without weakening issuance or revocation, expose usable sender construction, and add no-default compile/API tests plus behavioral parity with std.
